title: TS-34 Host worker: Chromium, boot, loop, disk lifecycle
description:
## Slice 2 ticket 34 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 34); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Port the Chromium executor, browser profiles, boot readiness gates, the claim-execute-report main loop, the protocol client, and disk lifecycle.

## Kind
mechanical-port: the Python source below is the specification. Keep its structure, names (camelCase), branches and messages. Do not redesign anything.

## Branch and commit
```text
git fetch origin
git switch -c ts/34-host-worker-chromium-boot-loop-disk-life origin/develop
...work, then...
git add <only the files listed under Files>
git commit -m "feat(conversation): host worker: Chromium, boot, loop, disk lifecycle

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -u origin ts/34-host-worker-chromium-boot-loop-disk-life
```
Do NOT open a pull request; the orchestrator opens it. Commit messages contain no emojis.

## Files to create or change
- `computer/host/src/executors/chromium.ts`
- `computer/host/src/browser-profiles.ts`
- `computer/host/src/boot.ts`
- `computer/host/src/main.ts`
- `computer/host/src/protocol-client.ts`
- `computer/host/src/disk-lifecycle.ts`
- `conversation/features-support/steps/host-lifecycle.steps.ts`

## Exported interface and error behavior
`main.ts`: hydrate on boot, loop `claim -> execute -> report` until the deadline, publish before exit. `protocol-client.ts` is `fetch` against the nine routes using the zod schemas of host-protocol. Chromium is driven exactly as chromium_action_executor.py does (check which library it uses with `grep -n import python/src/chatticus/chromium_action_executor.py` and pick the same underlying protocol; stop and report if the equivalent Node library is not obvious).

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.

## Python source to port (keep structure; read it fully before writing)
- `python/src/chatticus/chromium_action_executor.py (147 lines)`
- `python/src/chatticus/browser_profiles.py (53 lines)`

Rule: mechanical ports keep the Python file's structure and cite the Python line range in the commit body. Behavior that no scenario encodes is still kept.

## Stop rules
If anything in this ticket is wrong, ambiguous, impossible, or contradicted by the code you find (a Python line range does not match, a step has no Python match, a library API differs from what is written, a scenario cannot pass without changing its text), STOP and report to the orchestrator with the exact file, line and observation. Never improvise, never weaken or delete a scenario to make it pass, never add a fallback or a compatibility branch.

## Python to delete
No production Python is deleted by this ticket (the one big deletion is ticket 40). The only deletions allowed: the per-feature step file of each feature newly added to the manifest, because the manifest vitest requires it: features/steps/chromium_host_executor_steps.py (if it exists), features/steps/computer_host_readiness_steps.py (if it exists), features/steps/computer_host_disk_lifecycle_steps.py (if it exists), features/steps/computer_host_workspace_recycle_steps.py (if it exists), features/steps/unsupported_browser_action_steps.py (if it exists). Shared step files (control_plane_steps.py, capability_policy_steps.py, messaging_steps.py, organization_steps.py and the like) are never edited here; the last ticket that uses them leaves them for ticket 40.
